title: OneManCompany: Self-Organizing AI Agent Operating System
summary: An open-source framework that orchestrates heterogeneous AI agents into a hierarchical company structure. It utilizes a Talent-Container architecture to decouple cognitive roles from execution environments, managed via a web-based pixel-art UI.
research_notes: Achieves an 85% success rate on the PRD Bench benchmark and features a distinctive pixel-art 'office' management interface.

evolution.summary: Evolved from the 'From Skills to Talent' research paper into a production-ready 'Agent Operating System' in May 2026. It introduced a Talent Market for modular agent deployment and an automated HR pipeline that performs agent retrospectives and performance-based offboarding.
